instruction: Candid full shot at eye-level of an indoor martial arts gym with gray padded walls. On the left, the man in the gray t-shirt (R2) stands in a defensive stance facing right, blocking with his gloved hands. On the right, the young man in the white t-shirt (R1) faces left, executing a high front kick with his right leg. His white shin guard makes contact with the midsection of the man in the gray t-shirt (R2). Both wear protective glasses and focus intensely on the sparring session. Even overhead gym lighting casts soft shadows on the gray floor.
elements: R1 executes a high front kick toward R2
R1's shin guard contacts R2's midsection
R2 blocks defensively with gloved hands while receiving R1's kick
